title: Turn blob instructions into clear toolkit tickets
html:
Maintainers receive one clear ticket that preserves the requested work.

What went wrong

The original instruction arrived as one unstructured block, so the outcome and proof were hard to find.

What changes

  1. Rewrite the instruction in the toolkit house format.
  2. Keep the original meaning and evidence.

Done when

The created ticket has a clear title and all required sections.
